title: IT Business Development Partner | Project-Based
description:
The Dime Technology is looking for motivated Business Development / IT Sales professionals who can bring genuine IT projects and customers.

This is a project-based commission opportunity. There is no fixed monthly salary. Your earning depends on the business you bring.

What We Offer:

1. 10% to 15% commission on successfully closed IT projects
2. No fixed salary limit on your earning
3. Work remotely
4. Long-term collaboration based on performance
5. Technical development and delivery handled by our experienced IT team

Example:

If you bring a $10,000 IT project in a month:

At 15% commission = $1,500

If you bring multiple projects, your commission increases accordingly.

Projects We Handle:

1. Web and Mobile App Development
2. Custom Software Development
3. ERP and Odoo
4. AI Automation
5. Business Intelligence and Power BI
6. Cloud and DevOps
7. Network and IT Infrastructure
8. Dedicated Development Teams
9. IT Outsourcing

Who We Are Looking For:

People who already have access to businesses, companies, startups, or decision-makers looking for IT solutions.

You do not need to be a developer. Your main responsibility is to identify opportunities, connect with potential clients, and bring projects. Our team will handle technical discussion, estimation, development, and delivery.

If you have a strong business network and can bring IT projects, this can become a serious income opportunity.

Interested?

Send us a message with your experience, industry network, and the type of IT projects you can bring.

The Dime Technology
IT Development | Outsourcing | Digital Solutions
